entries.title: How prepared is Kenya for an Ebola outbreak?

entries.title: Germany, France agree on deal to support Europe's struggling car industry

entries.title: Clashes erupt at Argentine student protests against President Milei's austerity policies
entries.snippet: Demonstrators clashed with police as President Javier Milei's decision not to release funding for universities brought students and employees to the streets. Protesters say the country's future is at stake.

entries.title: Who was Eva Mamlok? Berlin square renamed after Jewish anti-fascist resistance fighter
entries.snippet: She started taking action against Hitler as a teenager and never stopped until her death in a concentration camp. Berlin's Blücherplatz is now being renamed after her.

entries.title: Europe promotes sovereign, trusted AI as it struggles to catch US and China
entries.snippet: At an international AI summit in Dublin, European leaders promoted trusted and independent AI. Critics question whether the EU can close the gap with the US and China while maintaining strict regulation.

entries.title: Formula One in Rwanda: Sportswashing claims vs. hopes for African legacy

entries.title: California wildfires force evacuations near Malibu
entries.snippet: A fast-moving fire near Malibu has forced evacuations. Stronger overnight winds threaten to spread the flames further.

entries.title: Wildfire kills 4 firefighters in Indonesia's Mount Bromo national park
entries.snippet: The latest victims of Indonesia's wildfires were trapped by thick smoke and fast-spreading flames, authorities said. Meanwhile, the toxic haze from the fires has spread to Indonesia's neighbors.

entries.title: India's 'Cockroaches' to march again after protest crackdown

entries.title: Starlink: How Elon Musk's company influences geopolitics

entries.title: Carney implies US trying to 'break' Canada amid vote for Alberta independence referendum

entries.title: Oregon school shooting: Gunman kills 3 students and teacher before being shot dead by community member
entries.snippet: A 16-year-old gunman opened fire at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, killing three children and a teacher. Two others were wounded. A community member pursued and killed the suspected shooter, authorities said.

entries.title: Venezuela's Nicolas Maduro pleads not guilty to torture charges
entries.snippet: Maduro and his wife were charged with leading a state-sponsored repression campaign that tortured scores of victims during his presidency from 2013 to 2026.

entries.title: Self-replicating AI: Is your fridge a cybersecurity risk?

entries.title: Middle East updates: Houthis target Yemen government palace in Aden
